user.title: Configure RCA Insurance Check
user.description: Enter the vehicle registration plate number to check RCA policy validity via AIDA (aida.info.ro).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the RCA browser service. Verify the service URL and that the service is running.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle plate is already configured.

init.title: RCA Insurance Check Options
init.description: Configure options for the RCA integration.

data_description.alert_preset: When to receive alerts about policy expiry

check_policy.name: Check policy
check_policy.description: Check RCA policy validity for a vehicle on a specific date (today or a future date). Returns the policy result and can remember an upcoming policy until its start date is reached.

plate.name: Plate / VIN
plate.description: Registration number or VIN to check. Defaults to the configured vehicle when only one is set up.

search_type.name: Search type
search_type.description: Whether the value is a registration number or a VIN.

date.name: Reference date
date.description: Date to check validity for (today or a future date). Defaults to today.

remember.name: Remember upcoming policy
remember.description: If the future date returns a policy for a configured plate, reflect it in the sensors on every poll until the date is reached.
